scope: Freeze following development analysis, not preregistration

author_decisions.preservation_rule: 95% paired-bootstrap CI lower bound of augmented-minus-unaugmented original macro-F1 > -0.01 (strict)

bootstrap.method: review-ID paired percentile, conditional on trained models, no multiplicity correction

hypothesis_rules.h1: lower CI bound for eojeol mean drop minus character mean drop > 0 supports H1
hypothesis_rules.h2: perturbed-gain lower CI > 0 AND original-change lower CI > -0.01; assess each representation separately; boundary crossing is inconclusive
